transcript.text: I kind of liked it when people overlooked me just a little bit. I kind of liked it because I kind
of thought, oh great, I'll show them, I'll teach them a lesson. Those days are done. As long as I
have this, as long as I am the undisputed WWE champion, no one ever overlooks me again.
No one, not any of you, not any of you, not anyone back there and not even Roman Reigns.
And he found that out the hard way because when Raw went off the air, Roman Reigns,
well he wasn't overlooking me, was he? He was looking up at me.
